name: BonjourAvis.ai
description: Google Business Profile review management for local businesses: AI drafts a reply to each Google review, in the language of the review; the business validates it or turns on automatic replies.
whenToUse: Replying to the Google reviews of a local business (restaurant, hotel, campsite, hair salon, medical or veterinary practice, gym, real estate agency, tradesperson, franchise network).
Replying to each review in the language it was written in, e.g. for a tourist or international clientele (100+ languages).
Automatically replying to new Google reviews according to their star rating, in the business's own tone and signature.
Clearing a backlog of unanswered Google reviews in one batch.
Managing the reviews of several locations or a franchise network, including access delegated through Google (Manager role).
Getting a free email alert for every 1-star Google review.
notFor: reviews on other platforms than Google (TripAdvisor, Booking, Trustpilot...)
capabilities: AI reply drafted for each Google review, in the language of the review (100+ languages, automatic detection)
Checks before publishing: no truncated text, no invented contact details, consistent language
Configurable tone: personas, signature, standing instructions
Automatic replies to new reviews, by star rating and delay
AI analysis of reviews (recurring themes, strengths, pain points)
Multiple locations and Google Manager delegation

humanOnboarding.steps: Sign in with the Google account that manages the Business Profile and grant access to its locations.

authentication.obtain: Create the key in the dashboard (Integrations) once support has enabled API access for the account. Keys carry permissions, an optional expiry and an optional IP allowlist.

api.scope: Only the locations connected by their owner or a delegated manager; no public access to a third party's reviews.

endpoints.description: Publish the generated reply on Google, or your own text

pricing.unit: per location per month, no commitment

plans.name: Essentiel
plans.includes: 10 replies per month, unused credits carried over

plans.name: Business
plans.includes: Unlimited replies, automatic replies, batch processing, AI analysis

pricing.trial: 14-day Business trial at first sign-in; not unlimited, each reply uses an offered credit

contact.support: Written support only, from the dashboard
